# Contributing

Contributions to MeetAgain are welcome. The full guide - development setup, code standards, commit messages and
tests - lives in [docs/src/contributing.md](../docs/src/contributing.md).

In short:

1. Set up the dev environment with the [Getting Started](../docs/src/getting-started.md) guide.
2. Open pull requests against the `development` branch.
3. Make sure `just test` passes before you submit.

Please follow the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Security problems go through the
[Security Policy](../SECURITY.md), not a public issue.
